name: A Taste of Her Blood
source:
Ksenia is a vampire who's lived among humankind for hundreds of years. After attending an unexpected party, she arrives home in the middle of the night and reflects back on her past life and how she originally met her wife: Eve.

A Taste of Her Blood is a kinetic visual novel developed from March to April 2026 for Sapphic Monster Girl Fluff Jam 2026.

[From [url=https://froey.itch.io/a-taste-of-her-blood]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
克塞尼亚是一个在人类中生活了数百年的吸血鬼。参加完一场意想不到的聚会后，她半夜回到家，回想起自己的前世以及最初是如何认识妻子伊芙的。

《她的血液的味道》是一部动态视觉小说，于2026年3月至4月期间为Sapphic Monster Girl Fluff Jam 2026开发。

[来自[url=https://froey.itch.io/a-taste-of-her-blood]Itch.io[/url]]
